title: agent-turn-cost splits each turn into the model's time, the tools' time (their waits included, calls side by side counted once) and the tail after the last step, with p50 / p90 per CMS
steps: S1: A Joomla session in the order dsh logs a step: two steps (model 2 s and 1 s), two tool calls side by side (3 s and 2 s), 3 s after the last step; read with --json and as the table.
expect: S1: seconds 9.2, modelSeconds 3, toolSeconds 3, tailSeconds 3; the table's time block reads joomla 1 turn, 9 / 9, 3 / 3, 3 / 3, 3 / 3.
evidence: Plan #1403 item 14: the tool counted steps, calls and tokens per turn but not where the time went; measured with it on the local stand 16/10/2026 (1311 turns): EmDash tools p90 101 s, Joomla model p90 53 s and tools p90 52 s
fence: Read off the session log only; nothing is estimated

tests: a turn is split into model, tools (calls side by side counted once) and the tail after the last step
a turn is measured by wall clock, steps, calls and NEW tokens — cacheRead kept apart
